prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A dimly lit classroom with a cool, bluish color palette, evoking a somber and contemplative mood. The main subject is a bearded man with dark hair, wearing a casual gray cardigan over a dark shirt, standing in front of a large projection screen. The man appears thoughtful and slightly intense, gazing toward the audience as if explaining or reflecting on the content behind him. The projection dominates the background, displaying a complex Go board with black and white stones arranged in an intricate mid-game pattern, suggesting a deep intellectual or strategic discussion. The room features utilitarian elements: a chalkboard partially visible to the right, and the ceiling with exposed beams and fluorescent lighting, adding to the academic atmosphere. The composition uses a slightly low camera angle, placing the man off-center and emphasizing the scale of the projected image. The lighting is soft but directional, casting subtle shadows and enhancing the introspective, almost cinematic quality of the scene. The overall style is realistic with a hint of dramatic tension, reminiscent of a thoughtful moment in a modern drama or science fiction film.
